row:
Hi, I'm Steph, a Certified Functional Nutrition Counselor, Licensed Massage Therapist, and Certified Equine Massage Therapist. I've dedicated the last decade to coaching clients and practicing massage therapy, craniosacral and myofascial techniques. 

I love all things crunchy and the holistic lifestyle. In my teens, I had chronic fatigue, digestive and reproductive issues that started at a young age. Through my own healing, I've learned what works and doesn't and it's helped me to empathize with my clients and give them the tools to heal their own bodies. 

I'm currently attending school to become an Acupuncture Physician in order to further learn body systems & root causes of imbalances in the body. It's my hope to empower women to heal their bodies through TCM and nutrient dense recipes so they can be their best for their families.
